drivers.title: Broadcom/Cypress Wi-Fi firmware (BCM43455)
drivers.summary: Lets the Wi-Fi of the Raspberry Pi 4, the PinePhone Pro and other boards with a BCM43455 connect.

license.name: Cypress (Infineon) firmware licence
license.text:
Sample catalog: this stands for linux-firmware's LICENCE.cypress, shown in full before installing. In short, it allows passing the firmware on in binary form, unmodified, for use with Cypress's wireless chips; it does not allow reverse engineering it; it gives no warranty.

Full text: https://git.kernel.org/pub/scm/linux/kernel/git/firmware/linux-firmware.git/tree/LICENCE.cypress

drivers.title: NVIDIA GPU firmware (GSP)
drivers.summary: Full speed and better power use for GeForce 16 and RTX 20 graphics with the built-in nouveau driver.
drivers.description: Without it, nouveau runs these graphics cards at their lowest clock speed. The firmware is NVIDIA's and is not open source.

license.name: NVIDIA firmware licence
license.text:
Sample catalog: this stands for linux-firmware's LICENCE.nvidia, shown in full before installing. In short, it allows passing the firmware on, unmodified, with NVIDIA's notice, for use with NVIDIA's graphics; it does not allow reverse engineering it; it gives no warranty.

Full text: https://git.kernel.org/pub/scm/linux/kernel/git/firmware/linux-firmware.git/tree/LICENCE.nvidia

drivers.title: Realtek Wi-Fi firmware (rtw88)
drivers.summary: Lets Realtek 802.11ac Wi-Fi adapters (RTL8821C, RTL8822B, RTL8822C, USB and PCIe) connect.
drivers.description: The rtw88 driver is built into Phoenix; the adapter's own program (firmware) is Realtek's and is not open source, so it is not in the system image.

license.name: Realtek firmware licence
license.text:
Sample catalog: this stands for the licence text the real entry carries,
linux-firmware's LICENCE.rtlwifi_firmware.txt (Copyright (c) 2010, Realtek
Semiconductor Corporation), shown in full before installing. In short, it
allows passing the firmware on in binary form, unmodified, with Realtek's
copyright notice and disclaimer; it does not allow reverse engineering,
decompiling or disassembling it, or using Realtek's name to promote
products; and it gives no warranty.

Read the full text at:
https://git.kernel.org/pub/scm/linux/kernel/git/firmware/linux-firmware.git/tree/LICENCE.rtlwifi_firmware.txt

drivers.title: Realtek RTL8812AU Wi-Fi driver
drivers.summary: A driver for USB Wi-Fi adapters with the RTL8812AU chip, which the Linux kernel does not include.
drivers.description: Open source (GPL-2.0), maintained outside the Linux kernel by the aircrack-ng project, and built for each Phoenix kernel.
